description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and encoding date/time ranges, including ISO 8601 validation, conversion between date strings and Dayjs objects, and encoding custom time ranges for use in a date filter control.

methods.name: dttmToDayjs
methods.description: Converts a date/time string to a Dayjs object, handling 'now' and 'today' as special cases.

methods.name: dttmToString
methods.description: Formats a date/time string into a specific string format using DAYJS_FORMAT.

methods.name: customTimeRangeEncode
methods.description: Encodes a custom date/time range object into a string representation, handling various mode combinations.
